description: A React component that displays a paginated list of documents with filtering options. It manages fetching data from an API, handling loading states, and rendering a table of document details along with navigation controls.

methods.name: fetchDocs
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches documents from the API using current filters and pagination, updating the state accordingly.

methods.name: onSubmit
methods.description: Handles submission of filter form, updating filters and resetting to the first page.

methods.name: onPageChange
methods.description: Handles page change in pagination, fetching new data accordingly.
